turns.text: It might rain on Saturday and we need to pick a plan for the kids.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hear me out on all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first idea is the zoo, which is fun but mostly outdoors.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's the science museum, all indoors, but it gets really crowded on rainy days.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is staying in with a fort, board games and a movie marathon.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The science museum is safe from the rain, but expect crowds since everyone else will have the same idea. The zoo could be great if the rain holds off, and it might even be quieter. Staying in is cozy and cheap, but kids can get restless.
